tagline: 美能达胶片单反相机，1998 年发布
description: 美能达于1998年推出的胶片单反相机。快门速度electronically controlled, 30 sec to 1/4000 sec. with bulb。使用35mm。感光度25 to 5000 ASA DX-coded (6 to 6400 manually)。

specs.快门: electronically controlled, 30 sec to 1/4000 sec. with bulb
specs.曝光测光: 14 field TTL measuring, spontaneously switchable to spot metering via central field
specs.闪光灯: guide number 12, selectable as autofocus support light
specs.重量: 350 g without lens, film, or batteries
specs.英文简介: The Minolta Dynax 505si Super is a light autofocus SLR camera for 35mm film made by Minolta.
